sloka: आरुह्य गिरिसङ्काशं प्रासादं हरियूथपः ।बभौ स सुमहातेजाः प्रतिसूर्य इवोदितः ।। ५.४३.४।।।।
transliteration: āruhya girisaṅkāśaṁ prāsādaṁ hariyūthapaḥ ।babhau sa sumahātejāḥ pratisūrya ivoditaḥ ।। 5.43.4।।।।

translations.english: Having slain the kinkaras, Hanuman stood and reflected, ' I have ruined the garden and not the palatial buildings that are like temples (Chaityas)'. Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, decided in his mind to show his strength and jumped on to the top of the palatial building that appeared like the peak of mount Meru.
translations.hindi: वह राक्षसश्रेष्ठ महाबली, रावणकुमार, सूर्य के समान दीप्तिमान, सुवणं- भूषित रथ पर सवार हो, हनुमानजी से लड़ने को रवाना हुआ
